content:
anya: Heads-up — noticed a spike in privileged role creations in prod via the SCIM connector starting ~09:04 UTC. ~42 new roles with admin scope created in a 3m window. Audit snippet:

```
2025-10-12T09:04:21Z audit=role.create role=team-admin subject=svc-scim-connector user_id=svc-scim-01 ip=34.120.12.4 request_id=abc123
2025-10-12T09:05:02Z audit=role.create role=team-admin subject=svc-scim-connector user_id=svc-scim-01 ip=34.120.12.4 request_id=abc124
```

sam: Was there a recent RBAC policy change? I pushed the `allow-scim-role-create` tweak yesterday in the rbac-config canary.

anya: Yes — that change rolled at 08:58 via canary. deploy-bot logs show overlap with the scheduled SCIM sync job.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started 2025-10-12T08:58:03Z for rbac-config v2.7

sre-oncall: Looking at job history — SCIM sync at 09:03 ran 8 batches. Connector identity is `svc-scim-01`.

mike: Could be a mapping mismatch — if the IdP asserts `role=admin` as a free string we map it to create privileged roles. Anyone have a raw SAML assertion?

anya: Pulled one from the forensics bucket:

```
<saml:Assertion>
  <saml:Attribute Name="groups">["engineering","admin-team"]</saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name="role">admin</saml:Attribute>
</saml:Assertion>
```

ida: Yep — that standalone `role` attribute is problematic. Our SCIM mapping currently does `if role == "admin" -> create role:team-admin`. We need normalization + source validation.

sec-bot: Security scan: SCIM service account keys for `svc-scim-01` are 98 days old (policy: rotate every 30d). Flagging for rotation.

sam: Hmm, stale keys are bad but logs show requests from one IP. Could be a replay or the connector got an expanded mapping after the RBAC change. Can we `gcloud kms decrypt` the service secret envelope and check last-unwrap time?

mike: Also grep audit for `subject=svc-scim-01 token_id=` to see token reuse patterns.

anya: Proposed immediate mitigations:
- disable SCIM connector `svc-scim-01` network egress (block)
- revoke outstanding tokens for `svc-scim-01`
- roll back RBAC deploy to v2.6
- rotate KMS key and re-encrypt service secret

ida: I'll start the revoke + KMS rotate now. Sam — can you roll back the RBAC change and open a stricter mapping PR? I'll own the incident playbook updates.

sam: Reverting RBAC change now.

deploy-bot: Rollback rbac-config v2.7 -> v2.6 started 2025-10-12T09:15:02Z :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Post-rollback metric: privileged-role creation rate dropped to 0/min after 09:20 UTC. Holding until forensics complete.

anya: Forensics tasks assigned: collect assertion samples, KMS unwrap logs, token usage ranges, correlate with deploy timeline. Created ticket SEC-2319.

sec-bot: Add: check KMS alias rotation logs and rewrap audit trail for any unusual rewrap operations.

mike: Suggest adding SCIM mapping hardening: require `assertion_issuer` in allowlist and `assertion_freshness < 5m`. Also require `groups` coming from `idp.groups` only, not free-text `role` attr.

ida: Good call. I'll draft mapping change + unit tests. Also adding alerting: threshold = 5 privileged role creations in 10m -> pager.

anya: I'll attach exported logs to SEC-2319 and add a summary. Thanks all. :lock: :eyes:

sre-oncall: Marking incident as mitigated (pending ticket updates). Will attach log exports and SCIM job traces to the ticket.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/rbac-config/pull/402 — adds normalized mapping + tests.

anya: Closing loop for now — keep updates in SEC-2319 thread and the PR. Great triage. :thumbsup:
